note: Core contracts deploy via deterministic CREATE2 with a global (chain-independent) salt per contract, through the standard CREATE2 factory 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C. Each core contract therefore has the SAME address on every chain, and so does the resulting Safe initializer / SMA address. Addresses below are placeholders until the redeploy completes; do not treat them as live. The same-address property holds only when the deployment uses identical configuration across all chains (governance, treasury, emergencyAdmin, feeManager, distributor, and all fee parameters). All deployments use zero fees (managementFeeBps=0, performanceFeeBps=0, initialPermissionRegistrationFee=0).
